run_gen_build_yaml: run the script to generate a YAML build configuration for the c-ares DNS resolver library
gen_ares_build: run buildconf and configure shell commands to generate c-ares build headers
config_platform: return the platform-specific ares_config.h header path for darwin, freebsd, linux, or openbsd
ares_build: return the path to ares_build.h, generating it via buildconf if it does not exist
summarize_gen_build_yaml: summarize the c-ares YAML build config generator that lists 50 C sources and 27 headers
